about_the_game:
Attention! Identical packages can not be activated on the same account twice!

Attention! Identical ships from different purchased bundles are not compensated!

This pack includes:

  • Rank 16 Jericho tackler “Singularity”

  • Unique EM weapon “Accelerator gun”

  • Active module “Trap mine”

  • Unique CPU modifier “Drone booster”

Additionally, the pilot receives:

  • 10% bonus to credits gain for 90 days

  • Unique title “Polyphemos’ bludgeon”

  • Unique pattern “Solar wind”

  • Unique decor “Star trackball”

  • A set of colours: “Aggressive carmine”, “Iris”, “Daffodil”

Additionally, the pilot receives ammo:

  • Dissonant charges — 15 pcs.

  • Crystal drone — 15 pcs.

  • “Radiation fog” missile — 15 pcs.

  • “Doomsday” missile — 15 pcs.

Additionally, the pilot receives the modules:

  • Active module “Sentry Drone”

  • Active module “Target Painter”

  • Active module “Shield Booster M”

  • CPU modifier “Spatial scanner”

  • Engine modifier “Catalyst Injector”

  • Engine modifier “Cruise Engine Modification”

  • Capacitor modifier “Multiphase Generator”

  • Capacitor modifier “Voltage Regulator”

  • Shield modifier “Adaptive Shield”

  • Shield modifier “EM-diffuser” (2 pcs.)

  • Hull modifier “Lightweight Hull”

  • Hull modifier “Extended Hull”

Special bonus for everyone who buys the bundle — Premium license for 30 days!

Every mercenary has heard of the mysterious Techs caste within the Jericho. Many have even done jobs for them, but no one has ever seen them face to face. The caste has always been closed off, even from other Jericho members. People say they don’t simply worship machinery, but consider themselves to be one with technology. When the Jericho disappeared along with the Techs, their creations were left behind. Now their former stations are controlled by a network of AI systems that call themselves Sentinels. Their goals and true nature remains a mystery, even to the few remaining Jericho people.

Despite AI operating on a completely different level, sentinels still manage to communicate and deal with humans. They have made many contracts with the Mendes family and a number of other factions. Autonomous AI units within powerful combat “Singularity” tacklers are the Sentinels’ emissaries and diplomats. They possess free will and sometimes make contracts with pilots to serve under them.
